data.title: Verdict: AcmeDB Is SWEATING
data.subject: AcmeDB
data.take: the boring database that actually ships
data.summary: AcmeDB does ONE THING — durable key-value storage — and does it without an operator PhD. No consensus wizardry, no sharding astrology; just a WAL, a manifest, and docs that answer the question you actually asked — NO BULLSHIT.

receipts.evidence: vendor benchmark on a laptop, not replicated
the docs list snapshots as 'coming soon'

data.bottom_line: Ship it behind a cache, fine, but do NOT put your crown jewels in that GODDAMN thing!
caveats: We did not run our own benchmark. The latency number is theirs, not ours.
Checked against the docs on the date above. Roadmaps move.

quotes.text: Cross-region replication is on the roadmap.
quotes.used_for: the single-region blocker that CHOKES any real deployment

quotes.text: p99 read latency under 2ms on a laptop.
quotes.used_for: the latency claim, read as a HARD CEILING, absolute fucking LIMIT!

footnotes.benchmark: Benchmark numbers are vendor-reported; treat them as the ceiling, not the floor.
footnotes.backup-gap: Backup gap confirmed against the docs page on demo-freeze day.
